item.title: Supreme Court: No blanket ban on use of pellet guns for crowd control
item.description: The Supreme Court ordered the Delhi government to treat all injured protesters. It questioned the feasibility of banning pellet guns for crowd control. The court directed the preservation of ammunition logs for effective investigation. It also emphasized the need for police to have adequate safety gear. The bench reiterated that peaceful protests can sometimes be hijacked by miscreants.
item.dc:creator: DHANANJAY MAHAPATRA

item.title: DoS, Isro launch major hiring drive for 746 posts, 92 will be scientist/engineers
item.description: Isro and DoS have initiated a significant recruitment drive for 746 positions. These openings include regular posts and apprenticeship opportunities for future talent. The drive aims to address a notable vacancy rate within the space department. Administrative roles and scientist/engineer positions are being filled across various centers. This effort seeks to bolster Isro's workforce and operational capabilities.
item.dc:creator: CHETHAN KUMAR

item.title: Middle East conflict: PM Modi reviews safety of seafarers, supply chain constraints
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired a special security meeting concerning the West Asia crisis. He directed the establishment of a mechanism to aid seafarers and their families. Discussions also covered ensuring uninterrupted fertilizer supply for the upcoming rabi season. The government's strategy to diversify energy sources has mitigated risks effectively. A whole-of-government approach is being continued to safeguard citizens' interests.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Liti's 223kg stunner denies Lovepreet CWG gold by 1kg in weightlifting
item.description: Liti produced a Commonwealth Games record lift of 223kg in the clean and jerk to move ahead of the Indian and win gold with a total of 389kg, just one kilogram more than Lovepreet. Liti had lifted 166kg in the snatch.
item.dc:creator: TOI SPORTS DESK

item.title: From 617 to 2,000 in 2025, Indians deported from US triple since 2023
item.description: Four hundred fourteen Indians faced deportation from the US by March 2026. Deportations from the US significantly increased from 2023 to 2025. The United Kingdom and Cyprus also deported Indians, with fifty-seven and fifty-three respectively. Government data shows thousands of unregistered agents were notified on the eMigrate portal. Indian truckers arrested in Arizona are also facing deportation proceedings.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: NYC banned Motoclick, now Mamdani targets Uber Eats, DoorDash over "hidden" tip buttons
item.description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani says the city's crackdown on Uber Eats and DoorDash tipping practices has delivered $104 million in extra tips to delivery workers since January. A new DCWP report shows tips per delivery doubled from $1.18 to $2.29 after apps were forced to show tip buttons at checkout. Mamdani, who earlier moved to shut down Motoclick, warns more enforcement is coming.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Release 3,500 cusecs of water to Tamil Nadu: Cauvery authority to Karnataka
item.description: The Cauvery Water Management Authority ordered Karnataka to release 3,500 cusecs daily. This directive mandates a total release of 4 TMC of water to Tamil Nadu. Karnataka had appealed the committee's order citing low reservoir levels and drought conditions. State officials stated reservoir levels were significantly lower than last year. Tamil Nadu representatives argued against Karnataka's plea, citing sufficient flow.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: 215 academicians slam Priyanka for 'gaumutra' remark
item.description: Over two hundred academicians have written an open letter criticizing Priyanka Gandhi Vadra's remark. They stated that dismissing scholars with labels undermines the nation's scientific temper. The academicians defended the IIT Madras director's advocacy of cow urine's potential benefits. They emphasized that scientific temper involves objective examination of claims before acceptance. Mockery is not a substitute for reasoned engagement in public debate, they added.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Ukraine dials India, seeks peace role amid ship attack concerns
item.description: India's External Affairs Minister discussed Black Sea shipping attacks with Ukraine's counterpart. He reiterated India's stance that such attacks are unacceptable and unequivocally condemned. The minister also highlighted the global impact of multiple conflicts on security. Ukraine's representative briefed him on recent developments and peace efforts. India consistently advocates for dialogue and diplomacy to resolve conflicts.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Kevin O'Leary says China's rise will unite US, Canada and Mexico
item.description: Kevin O'Leary suggests China's growing power will unite North American economies. Canada offers minerals and energy, while the US provides scale and innovation. Mexico also plays a vital role in the regional economic landscape. Companies are increasingly using cheaper Chinese artificial intelligence models. This shift occurs as the race for technological dominance accelerates globally.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Teen’s nuclear energy idea could cut Antarctic base emissions by 3,254 tons
item.description: A young Chilean student has proposed an innovative energy system for Antarctica. This concept combines renewable sources with a nuclear microreactor for reliable power. The system aims to significantly reduce diesel fuel dependence and carbon emissions. It offers a potential solution for powering remote research stations in extreme conditions. This student-led idea highlights future possibilities for sustainable Antarctic energy.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Trump invites 16-year-old California lifeguard hero to White House
item.description: President Donald Trump has invited 16-year-old California lifeguard Ryder Williams and his family to the White House after the teenager rescued a young boy from powerful waves at Seabright State Beach. Trump said Williams deserves a high civilian honour for his bravery. The dramatic rescue, captured on video, has drawn widespread praise from officials, witnesses and social media users, with many calling the rookie lifeguard true hero
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Viral Nausicaä radar domes video: Crew look insect-sized on $500m yacht
item.description: Yusaku Maezawa's superyacht Nausicaä is drawing attention for its large satellite equipment. This 374-foot vessel was designed by Marc Newson, known for his Apple Watch work. The yacht's massive domes are radomes protecting delicate satellite receivers from the marine environment. Nausicaä functions as a high-tech floating resort, supporting many guests and crew members. It utilizes advanced propulsion and satellite links for operational data transmission.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: After PM row, new Meta protocols for VIP accounts
item.description: Meta has introduced new protocols for handling prominent individuals' accounts. This follows the temporary removal of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's Facebook video. The company expressed regret and is examining the reasons behind the video's removal. Government officials are scheduled to meet with Meta's global representatives soon. Discussions will cover policy and technical aspects of the incident.
item.dc:creator: AABHAS SHARMA

item.title: R Madhavan reveals why he relocated to Dubai for his son Vedant
item.description: R Madhavan had opened up about the real reason behind relocating to Dubai, revealing that the move was driven by his son Vedant's swimming career during the Covid-19 pandemic. The actor had also spoken about life in the UAE, why he believed there were "three Dubais," his enduring connection with India, and even his upcoming South Indian filter coffee venture.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: Laid off after 10 years, Reddit user reveals how AI helped land a Rs 1.5 crore job
item.description: A professional secured a new job after an unexpected layoff and a lengthy search. Artificial intelligence tools significantly aided interview preparation and response crafting. The user pasted job descriptions and interviewer details into AI for tailored practice. This strategic preparation led to a job offer with a substantial salary and benefits. The experience highlights AI's evolving role in modern job seeking strategies.
item.dc:creator: TOI TRENDING DESK

item.title: How Kai Cenat became one of the world's biggest streamers
item.description: Kai Cenat’s rise began with comedy videos on Instagram before expanding to YouTube, joining AMP, and later becoming one of Twitch’s biggest stars. His success came through years of consistent work rather than one viral moment. Today, his personality, audience connection, and creative live streams have made him one of the most influential digital creators in the world.
item.dc:creator: SUMIT ROY

item.title: Patriots, Chargers linked to $62M Buccaneers DT amid trade rumors
item.description: Vita Vea requested a trade from the Tampa Bay Buccaneers after contract extension talks failed. New England Patriots and Los Angeles Chargers are top candidates for the 31-year-old defensive tackle at the moment. With the Patriots, he could form a Super Bowl-rich defensive front. With the Chargers, he could be a better disruptor than the current one.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Why Lamine Yamal says he can never repay his mother's sacrifices
item.description: Lamine Yamal, the 19-year-old World Cup winner, has spoken openly about a childhood shaped by financial hardship and parental sacrifice. His mother, Sheila Ebana, emigrated from Equatorial Guinea to Spain as a teenager, had Yamal at 16, and raised him largely alone after separating from his father when Lamine was three. Yamal credits her with shielding him from the worst of their circumstances, saying she made him see only the beautiful side of life. He also reflected on his rapid rise at Barcelona, describing himself as a creative and entertaining player who never anticipated reaching the first team quite so quickly
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: BJP submits breach of privilege notice against Rahul Gandhi
item.description: BJP submitted a privilege notice against Rahul Gandhi in Lok Sabha. He is accused of demeaning Parliament and insulting citizens with his remarks. BJP seeks an unconditional apology from the Congress leader. The notice cites rules regarding defamatory allegations against individuals. The matter has been sent to the privilege committee for inquiry.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: J&K: Properties of 5 Pakistan-based terrorist handlers attached in Reasi
item.description: Jammu and Kashmir Police attached properties belonging to five Pakistan-based terrorist handlers in Reasi district. This action aims to prevent the misuse of these assets for terror financing activities. The attached land was linked to a case registered under stringent anti-terror laws. Investigations revealed the accused had exfiltrated to Pakistan for terrorist training and now operate as handlers.
item.dc:creator: SANJAY KHAJURIA

item.title: 23 heritage sites in Ladakh declared protected monuments
item.description: Ladakh's Lieutenant Governor Vinai Kumar Saxena declared twenty-three heritage sites protected monuments. This initiative provides legal protection for Ladakh's rich archaeological and historical heritage. Sites in Leh and Kargil districts were notified as protected monuments under a specific act. The administration will now undertake conservation measures and prevent encroachments on these sites. This move reflects a commitment to preserving Ladakh's unique historical legacy for future generations.
item.dc:creator: NASEER GANAI

item.title: 'Children's future won't be compromised': PM Modi hails anti-paper leak Bill in new video
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced Parliament passed a new bill to prevent unfair means in public examinations. This legislation aims to build a more trustworthy examination system across the nation. The government has taken continuous steps to improve examination processes and address paper leaks. This new law will ensure no paper leak mafia or gang playing with students' futures is spared.
item.dc:creator: AYUSH PANDEY

item.title: CJP protest fallout: Noida woman booked over 'objectionable' remarks against PM Modi
item.description: Noida Police registered a zero FIR against a 25-year-old woman for alleged objectionable language. The complaint was filed by Supreme Court advocate Smriti Singh after receiving several videos. The accused, Ruchika Singh, was identified and details were gathered by the complainant. Police registered the case under relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita. The investigation has been transferred to Delhi Police for further proceedings.
item.dc:creator: AVISHEK KUMAR

item.title: US signs $58.6bn mega deal for Patriot missiles as stock runs low amid Iran war
item.description: The United States awarded Lockheed Martin a significant contract for Patriot interceptor missiles. This deal ensures long-term production of crucial air defence interceptors for the US Army. Concerns over dwindling missile stockpiles influenced this major procurement decision. The agreement aims to triple production capacity and boost employment at a key facility. This expansion supports broader Pentagon efforts to accelerate weapons manufacturing globally.
item.dc:creator: AYUSH PANDEY

item.title: John F Kennedy's travel quote that can transform every vacation
item.description: Meaningful journeys are measured by personal transformation and enduring memories. Challenging adventures create stronger recollections than passive, easy experiences. Effort justification highlights how commitment increases the perceived value of an experience. Travel should be about personal change and cultural understanding, not just convenience. Authentic experiences and genuine connections define worthwhile journeys today.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: Baker Mayfield fires warning after Buccaneers contract talks stall
item.description: Baker Mayfield feels disrespected and undervalued by the Buccaneers' contract offer. He has frozen negotiations until after the 2026 season concludes. Mayfield believes he is a franchise quarterback deserving of a higher salary. He is entering the final year of his current contract with the team. This situation creates significant pressure on the Buccaneers' front office.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: J&K: Govt clears funds for pellet survivor Insha’s gas agency after 8-year wait
item.description: The J&K government approved a gas agency for Insha Mushtaq eight years later. This rehabilitation pledge was approved on Thursday, reviving a commitment made in 2016. Insha lost her eyesight at fourteen after a pellet gun incident during protests. She has since learned Braille and is pursuing a bachelor's degree. The approval marks a significant turning point for her future.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Horoscope today: Daily astrological predictions for Friday
item.description: Horoscope Today: Read daily horoscope predictions for July 31, 2026. Know all about the astrological events and influences that will be affecting each of the 12 zodiac signs. Our astrologer has analyzed the movements of the planets and the alignment of the stars to bring you the most accurate and up-to-date horoscope predictions for the day ahead. Get ready to discover what the stars have in store for you today.

item.title: Future India captain? Selector explains why Sooryavanshi was named East Zone vice-captain
item.description: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, aged fifteen, has been appointed East Zone vice-captain for the upcoming Duleep Trophy. Selectors believe this move invests in the future of Indian cricket and accelerates his development. Ishan Kishan will captain the team, easing immediate leadership pressure on the young player. Sooryavanshi's prior leadership roles and strong IPL performance informed this significant selection.

item.title: ICC unveils 12 venues for ODI WC 2027 as Africa hosts showpiece after 24 years
item.description: The ICC has revealed twelve host venues for the 2027 Cricket World Cup. South Africa, Zimbabwe, and Namibia will jointly host the prestigious fifty-over tournament. This event marks the World Cup's return to Africa after a twenty-four-year absence. The tournament will feature fifty-seven matches and fourteen teams competing across three stages. The official brand identity 'Three Nations, One Heartbeat' symbolises unity among the co-hosts.
item.dc:creator: TOI SPORTS DESK

item.title: Joint property ownership: What happens when co-owners disagree over rent or sale
item.description: A growing number of buyers are opting for shared homeownership to alleviate financial strain and share loan obligations. In various states, including a woman as a co-owner can unlock potential stamp duty reductions. However, this arrangement necessitates mutual consent for the sale of the property and any loan matters, with each co-owner entitled to sell their respective portion. Disputes between co-owners can result in negotiations, buyouts, or legal partitions.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: ‘Unlucky’ taunts, dowry demands: Dehradun teacher dies, husband, in-laws booked
item.description: A young teacher died by suicide following alleged dowry harassment by her husband and in-laws. The victim faced months of physical and mental abuse after her marriage last November. Her family filed a police complaint accusing her husband and his relatives of cruelty. Authorities registered a dowry death case against the accused individuals and family members. An investigation is currently underway following the tragic incident in Dehradun.
item.dc:creator: KALYAN DAS

item.description: An Odisha medical postgraduate examination question paper was allegedly shared on social media. This incident occurred on July 27 during the All Odisha Medical PG Examination. Images of the General Surgery second paper were reportedly circulated in WhatsApp groups. An internal investigation is now underway to determine how this happened. Authorities are tightening security for the remaining examinations.

item.title: 'How is unelected minister continuing for over six months?' SC raps Bihar govt
item.description: The Supreme Court questioned the Bihar government regarding a minister's continued service. This minister has served beyond the six-month constitutional limit without legislative election. The court seeks an explanation for this continuation under Article 164(4) of the Constitution. A petition challenges the minister's reappointment after a government change. The court referenced a prior judgment on similar constitutional provisions.
item.dc:creator: AYUSH PANDEY

item.title: NEET-UG 2026 case: CBI links leak to teachers who set paper, did translation work
item.description: In a shocking revelation, subject experts are accused of memorizing and leaking NEET-UG 2026 exam questions after receiving daily access from home. These reconstructed queries found their way into private coaching classes, with a beautician reportedly formatting them for sale. The scheme's spread across multiple states is now under scrutiny, leading the CBI to file a chargesheet against thirteen individuals implicated in this alleged scam.
item.dc:creator: PRIYANKA JAISWAL
